description: Convert any whole number up to 9 quadrillion into English words. Perfect for writing checks, invoices and legal documents.

faqs.q: How large a number can it convert?
faqs.a: Any whole number from −9,007,199,254,740,991 to +9,007,199,254,740,991 (JavaScript's maximum safe integer), covering up to quadrillions.
Yes — a negative input is prefixed with “minus”, e.g. −42 becomes “minus forty-two”.

faqs.q: Is this the style used on checks?
faqs.a: It produces standard US-style words without “and” (one hundred twenty-three). For checks, banks usually accept this; add “and 00/100” for cents yourself.

howto: Type any whole number (decimals are not supported).
Copy the result for your check, invoice or document.
Negative numbers are converted with a “minus” prefix.
title: Number to Words Converter
